name: Malta environmental contribution (adult accommodation levy)
address: Charged on the provider's separate invoice/receipt; AX ODYCY booking and coverage are unverified.
hours: Rate effective 1 July 2026; charged per night of licensed accommodation.
price range: €1.50 per night per guest aged 18+ at start of visit; capped at €22.50 per person per visit.
description: The Malta Tourism Authority says the contribution must be shown separately from the accommodation rate. A six-night stay costs €9 per eligible adult before any coverage/booking adjustment; the cap is €22.50 per person per visit. Check the hotel's invoice and whether any sponsor/prize covers it.
notes: MTA official environmental-contribution rate/cap and separate-billing guidance, effective 1 Jul 2026. Calculation for six nights is €1.50 × nights × adults, capped at €22.50 per person. Not proof of a hotel booking or what a third party will pay.

name: MPT day-service single fare — October changeover unknown
address: Not applicable; check the exact route/stop and date in Tallinja.
hours: Single journey valid for two hours; fare depends on the current seasonal rate.
price range: €2.00 winter / €2.50 summer per single journey in the current fare material. October 2026 season switch date not published in the reviewed page.
description: Use a €2.00–€2.50 planning range per separately paid single journey until Malta Public Transport publishes/clarifies the October 2026 rate. This is not a door-to-door trip cost or a recommendation to buy a card.
notes: MPT fare page lists €2 winter and €2.50 summer fares and two-hour validity; the dated winter period currently ends 13 Jun 2026. October 2026 changeover remains OQ-05. Enter the number of separately paid journeys in the planner, or enter the actual card cost instead—not both for the same rides.

name: MPT 12 Single Day Journeys card
address: Available at MPT sales offices, ticket machines, authorised outlets and the Tallinja app (check actual purchase method).
hours: 12 journeys; each journey includes free transfers within two hours; card expires six months after first use.
description: A shareable card that can be used by a group and may suit several travellers making a modest number of bus journeys. MPT describes special-service/Airport Direct use as consuming extra card journeys; check current route eligibility and the actual trip plan before buying.
notes: Official MPT fare page lists the €19 card, 12 journeys, two-hour transfer validity and sharing. Airport Direct and selected-special-service use has different journey deductions; verify the exact route before purchase.

name: Explore Adult 7-Day bus card
address: MPT sales offices; check current availability and exact card/product terms.
hours: Seven consecutive days from validation; MPT says it covers Day Routes, Night Routes and select Special Services.
price range: €25 per adult card, as listed 9 Oct 2026.
description: Potentially useful for a seven-calendar-day visit with frequent bus journeys. MPT states that Tallinja Direct routes are excluded. It does not fully resolve every Airport Direct/special-service distinction for this specific trip; check the route/product before purchase.
notes: Official MPT fare page lists the product and price. Airport Direct vs Tallinja Direct coverage is not assumed here; see transport page and OQ-06.

name: Explore Flex 7-Day option
address: MPT sales offices, machines and app; verify chosen combination before purchase.
hours: Seven-day unlimited bus travel, with selectable Gozo ferry/harbour-cruise options; product variants differ.
price range: €27 for the listed seven-day bus-only Explore Flex option; two Airport Direct trips may be added for €6 per MPT page.
description: MPT lists a seven-day Explore Flex product and separately describes an option to buy two Airport Direct trips for €6. Compare the exact bundle and trip needs with the standard Explore Adult product before purchase; do not double-count included trips.
notes: Official MPT fare page; current product bundles and prices may change. Exact package/route treatment should be confirmed in the live purchase flow.

name: Malta National Aquarium admission
address: Triq it-Trunċiera, San Pawl il-Baħar SPB 1500, Malta.
hours: Current operator page lists daily 10:00–20:00; check visit-day schedule.
price range: Adult 13+: all-day €16.90 online / €17.90 door; after 16:00 €13.90 online / €17.90 door. Children and seniors have separate rates.
description: A current-source admission example near the hotel. Online/door rates, age proof and after-16:00 entry conditions differ; use the live official ticket page before purchase.
notes: Ticket rate snapshot checked 9 Oct; after-16:00 adult ticket is admission strictly after 16:00. Address/hours: https://aquarium.com.mt/contact/ .

name: Malta Classic Car Collection admission
address: Qawra, St Paul's Bay, Malta; use the operator map/contact to confirm the current entrance.
hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; weekends and public holidays 09:00–14:00, per operator page.
description: Official operator example price for an indoor museum visit. Rates/hours may change; call/check the live ticket page before visiting.
notes: Operator ticket page lists adult and child rates; hours are on https://www.classiccarsmalta.com/ .

name: Ħaġar Qim & Mnajdra Archaeological Park admission
address: Ħaġar Qim and Mnajdra Archaeological Park, Triq Ħaġar Qim, Qrendi, Malta.
hours: Check the Heritage Malta opening-hours page for the visit date.
price range: Adult €10; senior (60+), youth (12–17) and students €7.50; child (6–11) €5.50; ages 1–5 free.
description: Current Heritage Malta ticket-price reference for the combo entry. The site is partially accessible; check current opening hours and access notes before travel.
notes: Heritage Malta attraction listing shows ticket categories/prices and links ticket sales and hours. Accessibility notes are summarized on Activities & gaming.

name: In Guardia · show or Fort St Elmo combo
address: Fort St Elmo and the National War Museum, Mediterranean Street, Valletta, Malta.
hours: Sunday 18 October 2026; show 11:00–12:00; combo museums open from noon.
price range: Adult €10 show-only or €17 with Fort St Elmo and National War Museum; other age categories differ.
description: Scheduled during the trip, weather permitting. Use the operator's ticket page for live availability; no ticket is assumed in the calculator.
notes: Official event page lists 18 Oct, show time, address and adult prices; it warns that weather may cancel.

name: Picnic in the 1800s at Borġ in-Nadur
address: Borġ in-Nadur Prehistoric Complex, Sqaq In-Nadur, Birżebbuġa, Malta.
price range: €55 adult/senior/student/child; €45 Heritage Malta member. Ticket availability not verified.
description: Official listed afternoon tea and historical re-enactment during the trip. The price is a dated listing, not confirmation that tickets remain available or that the traveler's dietary/access needs can be met.
notes: Official event page; live ticket page https://heritagemalta.mt/store/e2112/ . Check ticket stock, dietary needs and access before committing.

name: Gżira United v Mosta FC match ticket
price range: Adult €10; senior/concession €6; under-16 entry free with ticket collected at the gate.
description: Official current ticket-listing prices for the match. It is a separate outing from TWC; do not count a ticket or trip unless chosen and still available.
notes: Ticket inventory can change. Adult/senior tickets and free under-16 gate tickets are listed on the Malta FA ticket page.

name: MULTIMAXX laser tag and VR
address: Bay Street Shopping Complex, Level 4, St Julian's, Malta.
hours: Daily 10:00–22:00; later visits by advance booking.
price range: Laser tag €8 / 1 game, €14 / 2, €18 / 3; VR €6 / 1 game or €10 / 2.
description: Published operator prices for walk-in laser tag and virtual reality; arcade coin/PlayCard spending varies. Not a PC-gaming café.
notes: Operator page says walk-ins are welcome and lists the prices. Confirm availability/group booking directly.

name: CDM Sundays · 18 October
address: Café del Mar Malta, Triq it-Trunċiera, Qawra, San Pawl il-Baħar SPB 1500.
hours: Advertised 18:00–01:00, last entry 23:00; FAQ says party ticket entry only after 20:00.
price range: Online ticket release €10–€15; ticket includes one drink token. Door ticket if available costs more and has no token.
description: A dated 17+ event with a published ticket range, but the FAQ entry rule conflicts with the advertised start. Do not include in the actual total until entry time, ticket availability and return transport are confirmed.
notes: Event page and FAQ checked 9 Oct; conflicting entry timing is OQ-25. Evening return bus service is not assumed; see Transport.
